# Pinned evaluator correction

This private replacement for Lucid's byte-oriented UPLC API uses **uplc 1.1.22**
with one source correction: `if costs.len() == 297` becomes `>= 297` when loading
the existing Plutus V3 bitwise builtin costs. The upstream parser otherwise
assigns its 30,000,000,000-unit unavailable-builtin sentinel when a ledger appends
cost parameters. The repository's unchanged 350-entry consensus-history fixture
exposed this failure. The entire supplied cost model, script and budget pass
through unchanged. No budget is increased and no script verification is skipped.

Upstream source: [Aiken revision 44fefdd](https://github.com/aiken-lang/aiken/tree/44fefdd44d252465d693202895a63088bc43fc6c/crates/uplc),
Apache-2.0. `prepare-upstream.py` verifies the published crate's SHA-256 before
extracting and applying the single, exact-match correction. We retain this
version's execution semantics; this does not enable future builtins or claim
support for future protocol semantics. The local package version is
`0.2.23+ibc.1`, not an upstream npm release.

Both Gateway (npm override) and offchain (Deno link and locked transitive
resolution) use these same artifacts. Keep the direct dependency: it makes
Deno install the linked npm package for transitive consumers. `deno.lock` must
resolve Lucid and utils to the linked version as well.

Build with Rust 1.97.1, wasm-pack 0.13.1 and LLVM clang 20.1.8. On macOS use
Homebrew LLVM rather than Apple's clang, which lacks the WebAssembly target:

```sh
CC_wasm32_unknown_unknown=/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang \
  python3 cardano/vendor/uplc/build.py
node cardano/vendor/uplc/verify.cjs
```

The default build compares every generated byte with `artifact-sha256.json`.
Use `--write` only when intentionally updating and reviewing the artifacts.
`rust/Cargo.lock` pins all Rust dependencies. Different compiler versions may
produce different bytes and must not silently replace the recorded artifacts.
The unchanged production consensus-history suite and protocol-10 migration
suite exercise both extended and original cost profiles with actual validators.
